sn11.11:1.2: Sakkassa bhikkhave devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesaṃ samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā || || 3.
sn11.11:1.8: Yāvajīvaṃ vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvaseyyaṃ muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato || ||
sn11.11:1.10: Yāvajīvam akodhano assaṃ || sace pi me kodho uppajjeyya khippam eva naṃ paṭivineyyanti || || 5.
sn11.11:1.11: Sakkassa bhikkhave devānam indassa pubbe manussabhūtassa imāni satta vatapadāni samattāni samādinnāni ahesuṃ || yesam samādinnattā Sakko sakkattam ajjhagā ti || || 6.
